As in the New Testament here, "знамение" is a sign that points to God's power (m2); the Readable says "чудеса".

source.text: זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: offspring of Israel his servant, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

en.L: you offspring of Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, \q you sons of Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chosen ones.
en.B: you descendants of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Israel, \q you children of Jacob, the ones {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose.
en.R: Do this, you who come from Israel, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, \q you descendants of Jacob, whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose.

es.L: oh descendencia de Israel {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, \q oh hijos de Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} escogidos.
es.B: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, descendientes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Israel, \q hijos de Jacob, los que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió.
es.R: {{plural_you:Háganlo ustedes, los que vienen|Hacedlo vosotros, los que venís}} de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, \q los descendientes de Jacob, a quienes {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió.

fr.L: vous, descendance d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \q vous, fils de Jacob, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} élus.
fr.B: vous, descendants d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \q vous, enfants de Jacob, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisis.
fr.R: Faites-le, vous qui descendez d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \q vous, descendants de Jacob, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisis.

sw.L: ninyi uzao wa Israeli, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q ninyi wana wa Yakobo, wateule {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: ninyi wazao wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli, \q ninyi watoto wa Yakobo, aliowachagua.
sw.R: Fanyeni hivyo, ninyi mlio wa uzao wa Israeli, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q ninyi wazao wa Yakobo, aliowachagua.

vi.L: hỡi dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q hỡi con cháu Gia-cốp, những người được chọn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: hỡi dòng dõi của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q hỡi con cháu Gia-cốp, những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn.
vi.R: Hãy làm như vậy, hỡi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q hỡi dòng dõi Gia-cốp, những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn.

ko.L: 그분의 종 이스라엘의 씨야, \q 그분께서 택하신 이들인 야곱의 아들들아.
ko.B: 그분의 종 이스라엘의 후손들아, \q 그분께서 택하신 야곱의 자손들아.
ko.R: 그분의 종 이스라엘에게서 난 사람들아, \q 그분께서 택하신 야곱의 자손들아, 그렇게 하여라.

pt.L: vocês, descendência de Israel, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo, \q vocês, filhos de Jacó, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} escolhidos.
pt.B: vocês, descendentes do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo Israel, \q vocês, filhos de Jacó, aqueles que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu.
pt.R: Façam isso, vocês que vêm de Israel, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo, \q vocês, descendentes de Jacó, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu.

am.L: የባሪያው የእስራኤል ዘር ሆይ፣ \q የመረጣቸው የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ።
am.B: እናንተ የአገልጋዩ የእስራኤል ዘሮች፣ \q እናንተ የመረጣቸው የያዕቆብ ልጆች።
am.R: ይህን አድርጉ፤ እናንተ ከአገልጋዩ ከእስራኤል የተወለዳችሁ፣ \q እናንተ የመረጣቸው የያዕቆብ ዘሮች።

hi.L: हे उनके दास इस्राएल के वंश, \q हे याकूब के पुत्रो, उनके चुने हुए लोगो।
hi.B: हे उनके दास इस्राएल के वंशजो, \q हे याकूब की सन्तान, जिन्हें उन्होंने चुन लिया।
hi.R: यह करो, तुम जो उनके दास इस्राएल के वंश से हो, \q तुम जो याकूब के वंशज हो, जिन्हें उन्होंने चुना है।

ru.L: вы, потомство Израиля, раба {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \q вы, сыны Иакова, избранные {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: вы, потомки {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} раба Израиля, \q вы, дети Иакова, те, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избрал.
ru.R: Делайте это, вы, потомки Израиля, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} раба, \q вы, потомки Иакова, которых {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выбрал.

ja.L: その方のしもべイスラエルの子孫よ、 \q その方に選ばれた者たち、ヤコブの子らよ。
ja.B: その方のしもべイスラエルの子孫よ、 \q その方が選ばれたヤコブの子らよ。
ja.R: その方のしもべイスラエルから出た人々よ、こうしよう。 \q その方が選ばれたヤコブの子孫よ。

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:6 reads "offspring of Abraham his servant". Here the line reads "offspring of Israel his servant", so both halves of the verse name the same ancestor, Jacob, who was also called Israel (Genesis 32:29). The rest of the wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: his servant: Israel; his chosen ones: Jacob's children
decisions.reason: "His servant" stands beside Israel, and "his chosen ones" (plural) beside the sons of Jacob. The people are addressed through their ancestor.
"Sons of Jacob" means the whole people descended from him, so Balanced and Readable say "children", as at Psalm 105:6; Literal keeps "sons".
Readable ended verse 12 with a full stop, so it links the people addressed here to the commands before them.
Chronicles names Israel where the psalm names Abraham; the Spanish changes only the name.
Chronicles has "Israel" where Psalm 105:6 has "Abraham"; the Psalm's Swahili is kept with this one change.
Chronicles has Israel where the psalm has Abraham; God's servant is "đầy tớ" at every level, as in the Vietnamese Psalms.
Chronicles has "Israel his servant" where Psalm 105:6 has "Abraham his servant"; the Korean of the psalm is kept with that one change.

decisions.choice: o seu servo (every level); filhos de Jacó (L, B)
decisions.reason: Israel as God's servant is a title of honour, and the English says "servant" at every level, so Portuguese says "servo" at Literal too, rather than the "escravo" Literal uses for the word elsewhere. "Filhos de Jacó" already takes in daughters, so Balanced keeps it where the English moves to "children".
As "my servant" and "your servant" are given in 2 Samuel 7 and in prayer.

decisions.choice: "याकूब की सन्तान" (B), "याकूब के वंशज" (R); Literal "याकूब के पुत्रो"
decisions.reason: As in the English: the "sons of Jacob" are the whole people descended from him. The English has no gender span here, so neither does the Hindi.
The Pentateuch note keeps "раб" for "eved" at every level; here it is Israel as the LORD's servant.

decisions.choice: 'avdo "その方の奴隷" (L), "その方のしもべ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As God's servant David in 1-2 Samuel (奴隷 L, しもべ B, R).

source.text: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: He [is] Yahweh our God; in all the earth [are] his judgments.

en.L: He [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God; \q in all the earth [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgments.
en.B: He, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, is our God; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rulings reach the whole earth.
en.R: He is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, our God. \q He judges what happens everywhere on earth.

es.L: Él [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios; \q en toda la tierra [están] {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} juicios.
es.B: Él, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, es nuestro Dios; \q {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decisiones alcanzan toda la tierra.
es.R: Él es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, nuestro Dios. \q Él juzga lo que pasa en toda la tierra.

fr.L: Lui, [il est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu ; \q dans toute la terre [sont] {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} jugements.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est notre Dieu ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décisions s’étendent à toute la terre.
fr.R: Il est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, notre Dieu. \q Il juge tout ce qui se passe sur la terre entière.

sw.L: Yeye [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu; \q katika dunia yote [zipo] hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Yeye, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiye Mungu wetu; \q maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanaifikia dunia yote.
sw.R: Yeye ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wetu. \q Anahukumu yanayotokea kila mahali duniani.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta; \q trên khắp đất [là] những sự phán xét của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta; \q phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vươn tới khắp đất.
vi.R: Ngài là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta. \q Ngài xét xử mọi việc xảy ra khắp nơi trên đất.

ko.L: 바로 그분께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님이시다. \q 온 땅에 그분의 판결들이 [있다].
ko.B: 바로 그분, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 하나님이시다. \q 그분의 다스림이 온 땅에 미친다.
ko.R: 그분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 우리 하나님이시다. \q 그분께서 온 땅에서 일어나는 일을 심판하신다.

pt.L: Ele [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus; \q em toda a terra [estão] os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} juízos.
pt.B: Ele, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, é o nosso Deus; \q as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} decisões alcançam toda a terra.
pt.R: Ele é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus. \q Ele julga o que acontece em todos os lugares da terra.

am.L: እርሱ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነው]፤ \q ፍርዶቹ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ [ናቸው]።
am.B: እርሱ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ አምላካችን ነው፤ \q ፍርዱ ምድርን ሁሉ ይደርሳል።
am.R: እርሱ አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። \q በምድር ሁሉ ላይ የሚሆነውን የሚዳኘው እርሱ ነው።

hi.L: वे ही हमारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हैं]; \q सारी पृथ्वी पर उनके निर्णय [हैं]।
hi.B: वे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे परमेश्वर हैं; \q उनके निर्णय सारी पृथ्वी तक पहुँचते हैं।
hi.R: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हैं, हमारे परमेश्वर। \q पृथ्वी पर जो कुछ होता है, उसका न्याय वे ही करते हैं।

ru.L: Он — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог наш; \q по всей земле суды {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Он, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — наш Бог; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} решения простираются на всю землю.
ru.R: Он — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог. \q Он судит всё, что происходит повсюду на земле.

ja.L: その方こそ、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。 \q 全地にその裁きがある。
ja.B: その方こそ、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。 \q その裁きは全地に及ぶ。
ja.R: その方こそ、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。 \q その方は、地上のどこで起こることも裁かれる。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:7, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.
The pronoun stands first for emphasis: this God who did all these things is the LORD, Israel's own God.

decisions.choice: his judgments in all the earth
decisions.reason: The God of one people is judge of every nation; he ruled over the kings of the nations for his people's sake (verse 21).

source.text: זִכְר֤וּ לְעוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember forever his covenant, [the] word he commanded for a thousand generation[s],

en.L: Remember {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant forever, \q the word {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded for a thousand generations,
en.B: Keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant in mind forever, \q the promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid down for a thousand generations,
en.R: Never forget {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, \q the promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made to last for a thousand generations.

es.L: {{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} para siempre de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, \q de la palabra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ordenó para mil generaciones,
es.B: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} presente para siempre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, \q la promesa que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estableció para mil generaciones,
es.R: Nunca {{plural_you:olviden|olvidéis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, \q la promesa que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo para que durara mil generaciones.

fr.L: Souvenez-vous pour toujours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, \q de la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prescrite pour mille générations,
fr.B: Gardez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance en mémoire pour toujours, \q la promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a établie pour mille générations,
fr.R: N’oubliez jamais {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, \q la promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faite pour qu’elle dure mille générations.

sw.L: Kumbukeni agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} milele, \q neno aliloliamuru kwa vizazi elfu,
sw.B: Liwekeni agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} mioyoni mwenu milele, \q ahadi aliyoiweka kwa vizazi elfu,
sw.R: Msilisahau kamwe agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q ahadi aliyoifanya idumu kwa vizazi elfu.

vi.L: Hãy nhớ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến đời đời, \q lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho một ngàn thế hệ,
vi.B: Hãy ghi nhớ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi, \q lời hứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định cho một ngàn thế hệ,
vi.R: Đừng bao giờ quên giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q lời hứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập để còn mãi đến một ngàn thế hệ.

ko.L: 그분의 언약을 영원히 기억하여라. \q 천 대에 명령하신 말씀을,
ko.B: 그분의 언약을 영원히 마음에 두어라. \q 천 대에 이르도록 세우신 약속을 기억하여라.
ko.R: 그분의 언약을 결코 잊지 마라. \q 천 대까지 이어지게 하신 그 약속을 잊지 마라.

pt.L: Lembrem-se para sempre da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, \q da palavra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ordenou para mil gerações,
pt.B: Guardem na memória para sempre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, \q a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estabeleceu para mil gerações,
pt.R: Nunca se esqueçam da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança, \q da promessa que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez para durar mil gerações.

am.L: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም አስቡ፤ \q ለሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃል፣
am.B: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም በልባችሁ ያዙ፤ \q ለሺህ ትውልድ የሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል፣
am.R: ቃል ኪዳኑን ከቶ አትርሱ። \q ለሺህ ትውልድ እንዲቆይ የሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል ነው።

hi.L: उनकी वाचा को सदा याद रखो, \q उस वचन को जिसकी आज्ञा उन्होंने हज़ार पीढ़ियों के लिए दी,
hi.B: उनकी वाचा को सदा मन में रखो, \q उस प्रतिज्ञा को जो उन्होंने हज़ार पीढ़ियों के लिए ठहराई,
hi.R: उनकी वाचा को कभी मत भूलो, \q वह प्रतिज्ञा जो उन्होंने हज़ार पीढ़ियों तक बने रहने के लिए की।

ru.L: Помните вовек завет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \q слово, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заповедал на тысячу поколений,
ru.B: Всегда храните в памяти {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет, \q обещание, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} установил на тысячу поколений,
ru.R: Никогда не забывайте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет, \q обещание, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал на тысячу поколений.

ja.L: とこしえにその契約を覚えよ。 \q 千代にわたって命じられた言葉を。
ja.B: その契約をとこしえに心に留めよ。 \q 千代にわたって定められた約束を。
ja.R: その方の契約を、決して忘れないようにしよう。 \q 千の世代まで続くようにと、その方がしてくださった約束を。

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:8 reads "He remembers his covenant forever": God keeps his promise. Here the verb is a command to the people, "Remember his covenant forever", like "remember" in verse 12. The rest of the line is the same as the psalm, and its wording follows the psalm's.

decisions.choice: the word he commanded for a thousand generations: a promise without end
decisions.reason: The "word" is the promise of the covenant, set in place by God's command. "A thousand generations" means for all time (Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: remember: keep in mind and live by it
decisions.reason: To remember the covenant is not only to recall it but to keep faith with it, as God himself does (Exodus 2:24; Psalm 105:8).

decisions.choice: Keep in mind (B); Never forget (R); the promise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the wording of Psalm 105:8 turned into a command, and say what the word is (m2).

decisions.choice: Acuérdense / Tengan presente / Nunca olviden (a plural command)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Remember!" where Psalm 105:8 says "He remembers"; the Spanish keeps the psalm's verbs but makes them plural commands with the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: Kumbukeni (L); Liwekeni ... mioyoni mwenu (B); Msilisahau kamwe (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the command "Remember" where Psalm 105:8 says "He remembers"; the Psalm's Swahili is turned into a plural command.
Chronicles has the imperative "Remember" where Psalm 105:8 says "He remembers", so the Korean of the psalm becomes a command to the people.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּעָת֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: which he cut with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,

en.L: which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cut with Abraham, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} oath to Isaac,
en.B: the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with Abraham, \q the oath {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to Isaac,
en.R: He made it with Abraham, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised it to Isaac with an oath.

es.L: que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} concertó con Abraham, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} juramento a Isaac,
es.B: el pacto que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo con Abraham, \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juró a Isaac,
es.R: Lo hizo con Abraham, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se lo prometió a Isaac con juramento.

fr.L: qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tranchée avec Abraham, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serment à Isaac,
fr.B: l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a conclue avec Abraham, \q le serment qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait à Isaac,
fr.R: Il l’a conclue avec Abraham, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a promise à Isaac par un serment.

sw.L: ambalo alilikata pamoja na Abrahamu, \q na kiapo {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kwa Isaka,
sw.B: agano alilofanya na Abrahamu, \q kiapo alichomwapia Isaka,
sw.R: Alilifanya na Abrahamu, \q na akamwahidi Isaka kwa kiapo.

vi.L: [giao ước] mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cắt với Áp-ra-ham, \q và lời thề của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với Y-sác,
vi.B: giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với Áp-ra-ham, \q lời thề {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề với Y-sác,
vi.R: Ngài đã lập giao ước ấy với Áp-ra-ham, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thề hứa điều đó với Y-sác.

ko.L: 아브라함과 맺으신 [그 언약을], \q 이삭에게 하신 그분의 맹세를 [기억하여라].
ko.B: 그것은 그분께서 아브라함과 맺으신 언약이요, \q 이삭에게 맹세하신 맹세이다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 아브라함과 그 언약을 맺으셨고, \q 이삭에게 그것을 맹세로 약속하셨다.

pt.L: que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez com Abraão, \q e do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} juramento a Isaque,
pt.B: a aliança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez com Abraão, \q o juramento que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez a Isaque,
pt.R: Ele a fez com Abraão \q e a prometeu a Isaque com um juramento.

am.L: ከአብርሃም ጋር ያደረገውን፣ \q ለይስሐቅም የማለውን መሐላ፣
am.B: ከአብርሃም ጋር የገባውን ቃል ኪዳን፣ \q ለይስሐቅም የማለውን መሐላ፣
am.R: ከአብርሃም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፤ \q ለይስሐቅም በመሐላ ተስፋ ሰጠው።

hi.L: जो उन्होंने अब्राहम के साथ बाँधी, \q और इसहाक से खाई हुई अपनी शपथ को,
hi.B: वह वाचा जो उन्होंने अब्राहम के साथ बाँधी, \q वह शपथ जो उन्होंने इसहाक से खाई,
hi.R: उन्होंने यह वाचा अब्राहम के साथ बाँधी, \q और शपथ खाकर इसहाक से इसकी प्रतिज्ञा की।

ru.L: который {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заключил с Авраамом, \q и клятву {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Исааку,
ru.B: завет, который {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заключил с Авраамом, \q клятву, которой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поклялся Исааку,
ru.R: Он заключил его с Авраамом \q и с клятвой обещал его Исааку.

ja.L: アブラハムと結ばれた[契約]を、 \q またイサクへのその誓いを。
ja.B: アブラハムと結ばれた契約を、 \q イサクに誓われた誓いを。
ja.R: その方は、アブラハムとこの契約を結び、 \q イサクに誓って約束された。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:9, and its wording follows the psalm. The only difference is in the spelling of Isaac's name, which the psalm writes with a different letter; the name is the same.

decisions.choice: cut a covenant: make a covenant
decisions.reason: A covenant was "cut", perhaps from the animals cut in two when it was made, as in Genesis 15:9-18.

decisions.choice: the covenant with Abraham and the oath to Isaac
decisions.reason: God made his covenant with Abraham and promised him the land (Genesis 15:18; 17:7-8), swore by himself to bless him (Genesis 22:16-18), and confirmed the oath to Isaac (Genesis 26:3-4).
Portuguese has no idiom "cortar uma aliança", so Literal says "fez", as Genesis 15:18 does in Portuguese; the meaning note explains the Hebrew "cut" (m2).
Russian makes ("заключает") a covenant; "разрезал" would not be understood as the idiom (m2), so even the Literal uses the Russian idiom.

source.text: וַיַּעֲמִידֶ֤הָ לְיַעֲקֹב֙ לְחֹ֔ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and he made it stand for Jacob as a statute, for Israel [as] an everlasting covenant,

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, \q to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set it in place for Jacob as a decree, \q for Israel as a covenant that lasts forever,
en.R: He made it a firm law for Jacob, \q a covenant with Israel that will last forever.

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo confirmó a Jacob como estatuto, \q a Israel como pacto eterno,
es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo estableció para Jacob como decreto, \q para Israel como un pacto que dura para siempre,
es.R: Lo convirtió en una ley firme para Jacob, \q un pacto con Israel que durará para siempre.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a établie pour Jacob comme une prescription, \q pour Israël comme une alliance éternelle,
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a confirmée pour Jacob comme un décret, \q pour Israël comme une alliance qui dure toujours,
fr.R: Il en a fait une loi solide pour Jacob, \q une alliance avec Israël qui durera toujours.

sw.L: {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akalithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa kanuni, \q kwa Israeli [kuwa] agano la milele,
sw.B: {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaliweka imara kwa Yakobo kuwa agizo, \q kwa Israeli kuwa agano linalodumu milele,
sw.R: Alilifanya kuwa sheria thabiti kwa Yakobo, \q agano na Israeli litakalodumu milele.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập điều ấy vững bền cho Gia-cốp làm một luật lệ, \q cho Y-sơ-ra-ên làm một giao ước đời đời,
vi.B: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xác lập điều ấy cho Gia-cốp như một sắc lệnh, \q cho Y-sơ-ra-ên như một giao ước còn đến đời đời,
vi.R: Ngài lập điều ấy thành luật vững chắc cho Gia-cốp, \q một giao ước với Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 그것을 야곱에게 율례로, \q 이스라엘에게 영원한 언약으로 세우셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그것을 야곱에게 규례로, \q 이스라엘에게 영원히 이어지는 언약으로 굳게 세우셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그것을 야곱에게 굳은 법으로 삼으셨다. \q 이스라엘과 맺으신 영원한 언약으로 삼으셨다.

pt.L: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a confirmou a Jacó como estatuto, \q a Israel como aliança eterna,
pt.B: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a estabeleceu para Jacó como decreto, \q para Israel como uma aliança que dura para sempre,
pt.R: Ele fez dela uma lei firme para Jacó, \q uma aliança com Israel que vai durar para sempre.

am.L: ለያዕቆብም ሥርዓት አድርጎ አጸናው፤ \q ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን [አድርጎ]፣
am.B: ለያዕቆብ ሕግ አድርጎ አቆመው፤ \q ለእስራኤልም ለዘላለም የሚኖር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገው፤
am.R: ለያዕቆብ የጸና ሕግ አደረገው፤ \q ከእስራኤልም ጋር ለዘላለም የሚኖር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उसे याकूब के लिए विधि ठहराकर स्थिर किया, \q इस्राएल के लिए सदा की वाचा ठहराकर,
hi.B: और उन्होंने उसे याकूब के लिए विधि के रूप में स्थिर किया, \q इस्राएल के लिए ऐसी वाचा के रूप में जो सदा बनी रहती है,
hi.R: उन्होंने उसे याकूब के लिए पक्का नियम बना दिया, \q इस्राएल के साथ ऐसी वाचा जो सदा बनी रहेगी।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} утвердил его для Иакова как установление, \q для Израиля как вечный завет,
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} установил его для Иакова как постановление, \q для Израиля как завет, который длится вечно,
ru.R: Он сделал его твёрдым законом для Иакова, \q вечным заветом с Израилем.

ja.L: その方はそれをヤコブには定めとして、 \q イスラエルにはとこしえの契約として立てられた。
ja.B: その方はそれを、ヤコブには定めとして、 \q イスラエルには永遠に続く契約として据えられた。
ja.R: その方は、それをヤコブのための確かなおきてとし、 \q イスラエルとの、いつまでも続く契約とされた。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:10, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: the promise renewed to Jacob, also called Israel
decisions.reason: God renewed the promise of the land to Jacob at Bethel (Genesis 28:13-15; 35:11-12), where he also confirmed the name Israel (Genesis 35:10). The two names here are the same man.
The word (choq) is something laid down that does not change. God bound himself to his promise as firmly as a law.

decisions.choice: set it in place (B); made it a firm law (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (he'emid) is to make something stand; Balanced and Readable keep that picture of firmness, as at Psalm 105:10.

source.text: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: saying: To you I will give [the] land of Canaan, [the] portion of your inheritance.

en.L: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, \q the measured portion of your inheritance."
en.B: saying, "The land of Canaan I give to you, \q a share marked out for you to inherit."
en.R: He said, "The land of Canaan will be yours. \q I am giving it to you as your own share."

es.L: diciendo: «A ti te daré la tierra de Canaán, \q la porción medida de {{plural_you:la herencia de ustedes|vuestra herencia}}».
es.B: diciendo: «Te doy la tierra de Canaán, \q una parte señalada para que {{plural_you:ustedes la hereden|vosotros la heredéis}}».
es.R: Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les daré|Os daré}} la tierra de Canaán. \q Será la parte que {{plural_you:les toca|os toca}}».

fr.L: en disant : « À toi je donnerai le pays de Canaan, \q la part mesurée de votre héritage. »
fr.B: en disant : « Je te donne le pays de Canaan, \q une part délimitée pour que vous en héritiez. »
fr.R: Il a dit : « Le pays de Canaan sera à vous. \q Je vous le donne pour qu’il soit votre part. »

sw.L: akisema, "Kwako nitakupa nchi ya Kanaani, \q fungu lililopimwa la urithi wenu."
sw.B: akisema, "Nchi ya Kanaani nakupa wewe, \q fungu lililopimiwa ninyi kuwa urithi wenu."
sw.R: Alisema, "Nchi ya Kanaani itakuwa yako. \q Nawapa ninyi kuwa fungu lenu wenyewe."

vi.L: rằng: "Cho con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban đất Ca-na-an, \q phần đã đo làm sản nghiệp của các con."
vi.B: rằng: "Ta ban cho con đất Ca-na-an, \q phần đất đã định cho các con thừa hưởng."
vi.R: Ngài phán: "Đất Ca-na-an sẽ thuộc về các con. \q Ta ban đất ấy cho các con làm phần riêng của mình."

ko.L: 말씀하시기를, "너에게 내가 가나안 땅을 주겠다, \q 너희 유업의 [측량된] 몫으로." 하셨다.
ko.B: "내가 가나안 땅을 너에게 주어, \q 너희가 물려받을 몫으로 삼게 하겠다." 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "가나안 땅이 너의 것이 될 것이다. \q 내가 그것을 너희의 몫으로 주겠다."

pt.L: dizendo: "A ti darei a terra de Canaã, \q a porção medida da herança de vocês."
pt.B: dizendo: "A terra de Canaã eu dou a ti, \q uma parte demarcada para vocês herdarem."
pt.R: Ele disse: "A terra de Canaã será de vocês. \q Eu a estou dando a vocês como a sua própria parte."

am.L: እንዲህ ሲል፦ «የከነዓንን ምድር ለአንተ እሰጣለሁ፤ \q [እርሷም] የርስታችሁ የተለካ ድርሻ [ናት]።»
am.B: እንዲህ ሲል፦ «የከነዓንን ምድር ለአንተ እሰጣለሁ፤ \q ትወርሱት ዘንድ የተከለለላችሁ ድርሻ ይሆናል።»
am.R: እንዲህ አለ፦ «የከነዓን ምድር የአንተ ትሆናለች። \q የራሳችሁ ድርሻ አድርጌ እሰጣችኋለሁ።»

hi.L: यह कहते हुए, "मैं तुम्हें कनान देश दूँगा, \q तुम्हारे निज भाग का नापा हुआ हिस्सा।"
hi.B: यह कहकर, "कनान देश मैं तुम्हें देता हूँ, \q तुम्हारे लिए नापकर ठहराया हुआ निज भाग।"
hi.R: उन्होंने कहा, "कनान देश तुम्हारा होगा। \q मैं इसे तुम्हें तुम्हारे अपने भाग के रूप में दे रहा हूँ।"

ru.L: говоря: «Тебе дам землю Ханаанскую, \q отмеренный удел вашего наследия.»
ru.B: говоря: «Тебе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} даю землю Ханаанскую, \q долю, отмеренную вам в наследство.»
ru.R: Он сказал: «Землю Ханаанскую {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдам тебе. \q Она будет вашей собственной долей.»

ja.L: こう言われて。「わたしはあなたにカナンの地を与える。 \q あなたがたの嗣業の割り当てとして。」
ja.B: こう言われて。「カナンの地をあなたに与える。 \q あなたがたが受け継ぐ、割り当ての地として。」
ja.R: その方はこう言われた。「カナンの地はあなたのものになる。 \q わたしはそれを、あなたがたの分として与える。」

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:11, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.
God promised Canaan to Abraham and his offspring (Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 17:8) and to Jacob (Genesis 28:13).
"To you" is singular, spoken to each of the fathers; "your inheritance" is plural, the share of the whole people descended from them.

decisions.choice: portion: a share marked out with a line
decisions.reason: The word (chevel) is a measuring cord, and then the plot of land measured with it (Deuteronomy 32:9).
Readable starts a new sentence and names the speaker, God.

decisions.choice: a ti ... de vocês (L, B); de vocês (R)
decisions.reason: God speaks to each of the fathers in the singular and of the people's inheritance in the plural (m3); Literal and Balanced keep the change with "ti" (God to one person) and "vocês". Readable says "vocês" throughout, as the English Readable smooths it.

decisions.choice: "to you" singular ("ለአንተ") and "your inheritance" plural ("የርስታችሁ", "ትወርሱት ዘንድ … ላችሁ"), as the Hebrew; inheritance (naḥalah) "ርስት"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes the change from one to many; Amharic marks number in the pronoun suffixes, so it comes through as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "तुम्हें", "तुम्हारे" for both the singular "you" and the plural "your"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from "you" (one) to "your" (many) (meaning m3). God speaking to people says "तुम" in this translation, which serves for both, so the change does not show in Hindi.
The Hebrew says "you" to one and then "your" to many (m3): the promise to the father is the inheritance of his descendants.

decisions.choice: le'mor before the quotation: "こう言われて。" (L, B), "その方はこう言われた。" (R), so that the quoted words end with 。 inside the bracket
decisions.reason: The verb of saying cannot follow the quotation without breaking the line order of the English; Japanese puts it before.

source.text: בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּמְעַ֖ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: When you were men of number, like a few, and sojourners in it,

en.L: When you were men of [small] number, \q very few, and sojourners in it,
en.B: When you were only a handful of people, \q a few outsiders living in that land,
en.R: At that time there were only a few of you. \q You were foreigners living in Canaan.

es.L: Cuando {{plural_you:ustedes eran|vosotros erais}} hombres de [poco] número, \q muy pocos, y extranjeros en ella,
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:ustedes eran|vosotros erais}} solo un puñado de gente, \q unos pocos extranjeros que vivían en aquella tierra,
es.R: En aquel tiempo {{plural_you:ustedes eran|vosotros erais}} muy pocos. \q {{plural_you:Eran|Erais}} extranjeros que vivían en Canaán.

fr.L: Quand vous étiez des hommes [en petit] nombre, \q une poignée, et des immigrés dans ce [pays],
fr.B: Quand vous n’étiez qu’une poignée de gens, \q quelques étrangers vivant dans ce pays,
fr.R: À cette époque-là, vous n’étiez pas nombreux. \q Vous viviez en étrangers dans le pays de Canaan.

sw.L: Mlipokuwa watu wa hesabu [ndogo], \q wachache sana, na wageni ndani yake,
sw.B: Mlipokuwa kikundi kidogo tu cha watu, \q wageni wachache walioishi katika nchi ile,
sw.R: Wakati huo mlikuwa wachache tu. \q Mlikuwa wageni walioishi Kanaani.

vi.L: Khi anh em [chỉ] là những người [ít] về số, \q rất ít ỏi, và là khách kiều ngụ trong [đất] ấy,
vi.B: Khi anh em chỉ là một nhóm nhỏ, \q ít người, là những người ngoại kiều sống trên đất ấy,
vi.R: Lúc ấy anh em chỉ có ít người. \q Anh em là người nước ngoài sống ở Ca-na-an.

ko.L: 너희가 수가 [적은] 사람들, \q 아주 적은 무리, 그곳에서 나그네로 [살] 때에,
ko.B: 너희가 겨우 몇 안 되는 사람들, \q 그 땅에 몸 붙여 사는 소수의 나그네였을 때에,
ko.R: 그때에 너희는 몇 사람 되지 않았다. \q 너희는 가나안에서 나그네로 살았다.

pt.L: quando vocês eram homens [de pequeno] número, \q pouquíssimos, e estrangeiros nela,
pt.B: quando vocês eram apenas um punhado de gente, \q uns poucos estrangeiros vivendo naquela terra,
pt.R: Naquele tempo vocês eram poucos. \q Vocês eram estrangeiros vivendo em Canaã.

am.L: በቁጥር ጥቂት ሰዎች በነበራችሁ ጊዜ፣ \q እጅግ ጥቂትና በእርሷም መጻተኞች [በነበራችሁ ጊዜ]፣
am.B: ጥቂት ሰዎች ብቻ በነበራችሁ ጊዜ፣ \q በዚያች ምድር የምትኖሩ ጥቂት መጻተኞች በነበራችሁ ጊዜ፣
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ እናንተ ጥቂቶች ብቻ ነበራችሁ። \q በከነዓን የምትኖሩ መጻተኞች ነበራችሁ።

hi.L: जब तुम गिनती के मनुष्य थे, \q बहुत थोड़े, और उसमें परदेशी,
hi.B: जब तुम मुट्ठी भर लोग ही थे, \q उस देश में रहनेवाले थोड़े से परदेशी,
hi.R: उस समय तुम बहुत थोड़े थे। \q तुम कनान में रहनेवाले परदेशी थे।

ru.L: когда вы были людьми [малыми] числом, \q совсем немногими, и пришельцами в ней,
ru.B: когда вы были лишь горсткой людей, \q немногими пришельцами в той земле,
ru.R: В то время вас было совсем немного. \q Вы жили в Ханаане как чужеземцы.

ja.L: あなたがたが数えるほどの者で、 \q ごくわずかな、その地の寄留者であったとき、
ja.B: あなたがたがほんのわずかな人数で、 \q その地に住む少数のよそ者にすぎなかったとき、
ja.R: そのころ、あなたがたはほんの少ししかいなかった。 \q カナンの地に住む外国人だった。

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:12 reads "when they were". Here the singers say "when you were", speaking to the people of their own day as if they had been there with their ancestors. The next verse goes back to "they", as the psalm has it. The rest of the wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: men of number: few, easily counted
decisions.reason: People who can be counted are few (Genesis 34:30; Deuteronomy 26:5, "few in number"). "Like a few" makes it stronger: very few indeed.

decisions.choice: sojourners: foreigners living in the land
decisions.reason: A sojourner (ger) lived in a land without owning it, under others' protection. Abraham called himself one in Canaan (Genesis 23:4).

decisions.choice: the "when" clause goes with what follows
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 105:12, the clause is taken with verse 21: while they were few and wandering, God protected them.
Readable names the land that "it" refers to, as at Psalm 105:12; it keeps the psalm's wording for the sojourners.
Chronicles says "when you were" where Psalm 105:12 says "when they were"; the singers address the people, so the plural "you" takes the setting.
Chronicles has "you were" where Psalm 105:12 has "they were"; only the subject prefix of the Psalm's Swahili changes.
Chronicles has "you were" where the psalm has "they were"; the singers address the gathered people, so the psalm's "họ" becomes "anh em", the word David uses to the assembly in 13:2.
Chronicles has "when you were" where Psalm 105:12 has "when they were"; the singers address the people, so the Korean says "너희".
"Estrangeiro", one of the Old Testament's two words for the ger (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), says plainly that they lived in a land not their own (m3).
Foreigners living in the land, as GEN and 2 Samuel 1:13.

source.text: וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֔וֹי וּמִמַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: and they went about from nation to nation, and from a kingdom to another people,

en.L: and they went about from nation to nation, \q and from a kingdom to another people,
en.B: wandering from one nation to the next, \q from one kingdom to another people,
en.R: They wandered from one country to another, \q from one kingdom to the next.

es.L: y anduvieron de nación en nación, \q y de un reino a otro pueblo,
es.B: vagando de una nación a otra, \q de un reino a otro pueblo,
es.R: Iban de un país a otro, \q de un reino al siguiente.

fr.L: et qu’ils allaient de nation en nation, \q et d’un royaume vers un autre peuple,
fr.B: errant d’une nation à l’autre, \q d’un royaume vers un autre peuple,
fr.R: Ils allaient d’un pays à l’autre, \q d’un royaume à un autre.

sw.L: nao walizunguka kutoka taifa hadi taifa, \q kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi kwa watu wengine,
sw.B: wakitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, \q kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi kwa watu wengine,
sw.R: Walitangatanga kutoka nchi moja hadi nyingine, \q kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.

vi.L: và họ đi từ dân tộc này đến dân tộc kia, \q từ một vương quốc đến một dân khác,
vi.B: lang thang từ dân tộc này sang dân tộc khác, \q từ vương quốc này đến dân kia,
vi.R: Họ lang thang từ nước này sang nước khác, \q từ vương quốc này đến vương quốc kia.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 이 민족에게서 저 민족에게로, \q 한 나라에서 다른 백성에게로 떠돌아다닐 때에,
ko.B: 이 민족에게서 저 민족에게로, \q 이 나라에서 다른 백성에게로 떠돌던 그때에,
ko.R: 그들은 이 나라 저 나라로, \q 이 왕국에서 저 왕국으로 떠돌아다녔다.

pt.L: e andaram de nação em nação, \q e de um reino para outro povo,
pt.B: vagando de uma nação para outra, \q de um reino para outro povo,
pt.R: Eles andaram de um país para outro, \q de um reino para o seguinte.

am.L: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ ተዘዋወሩ፤ \q ከመንግሥትም ወደ ሌላ ወገን፣
am.B: ከአንዱ ሕዝብ ወደ ሌላው ይንከራተቱ ነበር፤ \q ከአንዱ መንግሥትም ወደ ሌላ ወገን፣
am.R: ከአንዱ አገር ወደ ሌላው ተንከራተቱ፤ \q ከአንዱ መንግሥት ወደ ሌላው።

hi.L: और वे एक जाति से दूसरी जाति में, \q और एक राज्य से दूसरी प्रजा के पास फिरते रहे,
hi.B: वे एक देश से दूसरे देश में भटकते रहे, \q एक राज्य से दूसरी प्रजा के पास,
hi.R: वे एक देश से दूसरे देश में भटकते रहे, \q एक राज्य से दूसरे राज्य में।

ru.L: и ходили они от народа к народу \q и из царства к другому народу,
ru.B: скитаясь от одного народа к другому, \q из одного царства к другому народу,
ru.R: Они скитались из одной страны в другую, \q из одного царства в другое.

ja.L: そして彼らは国から国へ、 \q ある王国から他の民へと渡り歩いたが、
ja.B: 彼らは国から国へ、 \q ある王国から別の民へと、さまよい歩いた。
ja.R: 彼らは国から国へと、 \q 王国から王国へと、さまよい歩いた。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:13, and its wording follows the psalm. Chronicles adds "and" before "from a kingdom", which does not change the sense. After "you" in verse 19, the line returns to "they", the ancestors.

Abraham went from Haran to Canaan and down to Egypt (Genesis 12:4-10) and lived in Gerar (Genesis 20:1); Isaac lived in Gerar (Genesis 26:6); Jacob went to Haran and back (Genesis 28-31) and at last to Egypt (Genesis 46:1-7).

decisions.choice: went about: walked here and there
decisions.reason: The verb (hithallekh) is to go to and fro, a life on the move without a land of one's own.
As in the New Testament (style guide, section 7b), "जाति" also means caste, so Balanced and Readable say "देश" or "लोग" for the nations in this song (verses 20, 24, 31, 35).

source.text: לֹא־הִנִּ֤יחַ לְאִישׁ֙ לְעָשְׁקָ֔ם וַיּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: not he allowed a man to oppress them, and he rebuked on account of them kings:

en.L: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} allowed no one to oppress them, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked kings on their account:
en.B: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let no one do them wrong, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took kings to task over them:
en.R: But God did not let anyone treat them badly. \q He warned kings to leave them alone. He said,

es.L: no permitió {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} que nadie los oprimiera, \q y por causa de ellos reprendió a reyes:
es.B: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no dejó que nadie les hiciera daño, \q y por ellos reprendió duramente a reyes:
es.R: Pero Dios no dejó que nadie los maltratara. \q Advirtió a los reyes que los dejaran en paz. Les dijo:

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a permis à personne de les opprimer, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a réprimandé des rois à cause d’eux :
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a laissé personne leur faire du tort, \q et à cause d’eux {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a sévèrement averti des rois :
fr.R: Mais Dieu n’a laissé personne les maltraiter. \q Il a averti des rois de les laisser tranquilles. Il a dit :

sw.L: hakumruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee, \q na kwa ajili yao akawakemea wafalme:
sw.B: hakumwacha mtu yeyote awadhulumu, \q na kwa ajili yao akawakaripia wafalme:
sw.R: Lakini Mungu hakumwacha mtu yeyote awatendee mabaya. \q Aliwaonya wafalme wawaache. Alisema,

vi.L: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho phép ai áp bức họ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách các vua vì cớ họ:
vi.B: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để ai làm hại họ, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trách phạt các vua vì họ:
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời không để ai đối xử tệ với họ. \q Ngài cảnh cáo các vua phải để họ yên. Ngài phán:

ko.L: 그분께서는 아무도 그들을 억압하도록 두지 않으시고, \q 그들 때문에 왕들을 꾸짖으셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 누구도 그들을 해치지 못하게 하셨고, \q 그들 일로 왕들을 꾸짖으셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서는 아무도 그들을 괴롭히지 못하게 하셨다. \q 왕들에게 그들을 건드리지 말라고 경고하시며 말씀하셨다.

pt.L: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não permitiu que ninguém os oprimisse, \q e por causa deles repreendeu reis:
pt.B: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixou ninguém lhes fazer mal, \q e por causa deles repreendeu reis:
pt.R: Mas Deus não deixou ninguém maltratá-los. \q Ele avisou reis para que os deixassem em paz. Ele disse:

am.L: ማንም ይበድላቸው ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፤ \q ስለ እነርሱም ነገሥታትን ገሠጸ፦
am.B: ማንም እንዲበድላቸው አልፈቀደም፤ \q ስለ እነርሱም ነገሥታትን ገሠጸ፦
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ግን ማንም እንዲያንገላታቸው አልፈቀደም። \q ነገሥታትን እንዲተዋቸው አስጠነቀቃቸው። እንዲህም አለ፦

hi.L: उन्होंने किसी मनुष्य को उन पर अंधेर करने न दिया, \q और उनके कारण राजाओं को डाँटा:
hi.B: उन्होंने किसी को उनके साथ अन्याय करने न दिया, \q और उनके कारण राजाओं को फटकारा:
hi.R: पर परमेश्वर ने किसी को उनके साथ बुरा व्यवहार नहीं करने दिया। \q उन्होंने राजाओं को चेतावनी दी कि वे उन्हें न छेड़ें। उन्होंने कहा,

ru.L: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не позволил никому притеснять их \q и обличал из-за них царей:
ru.B: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не дал никому обидеть их \q и строго взыскал с царей из-за них:
ru.R: Но Бог не позволил никому обижать их. \q Он предупредил царей, чтобы они их не трогали. Он сказал:

ja.L: その方はだれにも彼らを虐げさせず、 \q 彼らのために王たちを戒められた。
ja.B: その方はだれにも彼らを害させず、 \q 彼らのために王たちをとがめられた。
ja.R: しかし神は、だれにも彼らをひどい目にあわせることを許されなかった。 \q 王たちに、彼らに手を出すなと警告された。その方はこう言われた。

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:14 has 'adam, "a human being", where Chronicles has 'ish, "a man"; both mean "anyone" here, and the wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: kings rebuked for the fathers' sake
decisions.reason: God struck Pharaoh because of Sarah (Genesis 12:17), warned Abimelech king of Gerar in a dream (Genesis 20:3-7), and Abimelech later forbade anyone to harm Isaac (Genesis 26:11).
Readable starts a new sentence, so it names God, and it introduces the words of verse 22 as his, as at Psalm 105:14.

source.text: אַֽל־תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Do not touch my anointed [ones], and to my prophets do not do harm.

en.L: "Do not touch {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed ones, \q and do no harm to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."
en.B: "Do not lay a hand on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed ones; \q do not hurt {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."
en.R: "Do not harm the people I have set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}. \q Do not hurt {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."

es.L: «No {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ungidos, \q y no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».
es.B: «No {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} la mano sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ungidos; \q no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».
es.R: «No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a las personas que he apartado para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No {{plural_you:lastimen|lastiméis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».

fr.L: « Ne touchez pas à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} oints, \q et ne faites pas de mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »
fr.B: « Ne portez pas la main sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} oints ; \q ne faites pas de mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »
fr.R: « Ne faites pas de mal aux gens que j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Ne maltraitez pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »

sw.L: "Msiwaguse wapakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wala msiwadhuru manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: "Msinyooshe mkono juu ya wapakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; \q msiwaumize manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.R: "Msiwadhuru watu niliowatenga kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Msiwaumize manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."

vi.L: "Đừng đụng đến những người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: "Đừng tra tay trên những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xức dầu; \q đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: "Đừng làm hại những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: "나의 기름 부은 이들을 건드리지 말고, \q 나의 예언자들에게 해를 끼치지 마라."
ko.B: "내가 기름 부은 이들에게 손대지 말고, \q 내 예언자들을 해치지 마라."
ko.R: "내가 따로 세운 사람들을 해치지 마라. \q 내 예언자들을 다치게 하지 마라."

pt.L: "Não toquem nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ungidos, \q e não façam mal aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."
pt.B: "Não ponham a mão nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ungidos; \q não maltratem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."
pt.R: "Não façam mal às pessoas que eu separei para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Não maltratem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."

am.L: «የቀባኋቸውን አትንኩ፤ \q በነቢያቴም ላይ ክፉ አታድርጉ።»
am.B: «በቀባኋቸው ላይ እጃችሁን አታንሡ፤ \q ነቢያቴንም አትጉዱ።»
am.R: «ለራሴ የለየኋቸውን ሰዎች አትንኩ። \q ነቢያቴንም አትጉዱ።»

hi.L: "मेरे अभिषिक्तों को मत छूना, \q और मेरे भविष्यद्वक्ताओं की कुछ हानि न करना।"
hi.B: "मेरे अभिषिक्त लोगों पर हाथ न डालो; \q मेरे भविष्यद्वक्ताओं को चोट न पहुँचाओ।"
hi.R: "जिन लोगों को मैंने अपने लिए अलग किया है, उन्हें हानि मत पहुँचाओ। \q मेरे नबियों को चोट मत पहुँचाओ।"

ru.L: «Не прикасайтесь к помазанникам {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} \q и пророкам {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} не делайте зла.»
ru.B: «Не поднимайте руки на {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} помазанников; \q не причиняйте вреда {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} пророкам.»
ru.R: «Не причиняйте зла людям, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отделил для себя. \q Не обижайте {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} пророков.»

ja.L: 「わたしの油注がれた者たちに触れてはならない。 \q わたしの預言者たちに害を加えてはならない。」
ja.B: 「わたしが油を注いだ者たちに触れてはならない。 \q わたしの預言者たちに危害を加えてはならない。」
ja.R: 「わたしが自分のために選び分けた人々を、傷つけてはならない。 \q わたしの預言者たちに、ひどいことをしてはならない。」

decisions.choice: Psalm 105:15: the end of the psalm's lines
decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:15, and its wording follows the psalm. The song takes no more from Psalm 105; it goes on with Psalm 96 in verse 23.

decisions.choice: my anointed ones: the fathers, set apart by God
decisions.reason: Kings and priests were anointed with oil. The fathers never were, but they were chosen and set apart by God as if anointed.
God calls Abraham a prophet who will pray for Abimelech (Genesis 20:7).

decisions.choice: the people I have set apart for myself
decisions.reason: Readable says what "anointed" means here (m2), as at Psalm 105:15.
God speaks to the kings in the plural, so Portuguese uses the plural "vocês" forms, as God speaks to a group throughout the Old Testament.

decisions.choice: meshichai "わたしの油注がれた者たち" (L), "わたしが油を注いだ者たち" (B), "わたしが自分のために選び分けた人々" (R); no christos span
decisions.reason: The patriarchs set apart by God, as the English; the Hebrew plural is not a title.

source.text: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־אֶל־י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth; bear news from day to day [of] his salvation.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth; \q bear news from day to day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation.
en.B: All the earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Day after day announce the good news of how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves.
en.R: Everyone on earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Tell the good news every day: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra; \q {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} de día en día {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} salvación.
es.B: ¡Toda la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q Día tras día {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} la buena noticia de cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva.
es.R: ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} la buena noticia cada día: ¡{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, toute la terre ; \q annoncez de jour en jour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut.
fr.B: Terre entière, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Jour après jour, annoncez la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve.
fr.R: Vous tous qui vivez sur la terre, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Chaque jour, dites la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve !

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia yote; \q pelekeni habari siku kwa siku za wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Dunia yote, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Siku baada ya siku tangazeni habari njema za jinsi anavyookoa.
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Elezeni habari njema kila siku: anaokoa!

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả trái đất; \q ngày qua ngày hãy loan tin sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Ngày này qua ngày khác, hãy loan báo tin mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy loan báo tin mừng mỗi ngày: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu!

ko.L: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. \q 날마다 그분의 구원을 기쁜 소식으로 전하여라.
ko.B: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라! \q 날마다 그분께서 구원하신다는 기쁜 소식을 전하여라.
ko.R: 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라! \q 날마다 기쁜 소식을 전하여라. 그분께서 구원하신다!

pt.L: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra; \q anunciem de dia em dia a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} salvação.
pt.B: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra! \q Dia após dia anunciem as boas-novas de como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva.
pt.R: Todos na terra, cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! \q Anunciem a boa notícia todos os dias: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva!

am.L: ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ፤ \q ማዳኑን ከቀን ወደ ቀን አብሥሩ።
am.B: ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ! \q እንዴት እንደሚያድን ዕለት ዕለት የምሥራቹን አውሩ።
am.R: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ! \q በየቀኑ የምሥራቹን ንገሩ፤ እርሱ ያድናል!

hi.L: हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ; \q दिन-प्रतिदिन उनके उद्धार का शुभ समाचार सुनाओ।
hi.B: हे सारी पृथ्वी के लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ! \q दिन पर दिन यह शुभ समाचार सुनाओ कि वे कैसे उद्धार करते हैं।
hi.R: पृथ्वी के सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ! \q हर दिन यह शुभ समाचार सुनाओ: वे बचाते हैं!

ru.L: Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля; \q возвещайте изо дня в день спасение {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Вся земля, пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q День за днём возвещайте радостную весть о том, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасает.
ru.R: Все люди на земле, пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q Каждый день рассказывайте радостную новость: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасает!

ja.L: 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え。 \q 日から日へ、その救いを告げ知らせよ。
ja.B: 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！ \q 日ごとに、その方の救いの良い知らせを告げよ。
ja.R: 地上のすべての人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！ \q 毎日、良い知らせを伝えよ。その方は救ってくださる！

decisions.reason: The song now takes up Psalm 96, which it follows to verse 33. This verse joins the second half of Psalm 96:1 ("sing to the LORD, all the earth") to the second half of Psalm 96:2 ("bear news from day to day of his salvation"). It leaves out "Sing to the LORD a new song" and "Sing to the LORD, bless his name". The wording of each half follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: all the earth: everyone on earth
decisions.reason: The whole earth is called on, that is, all its peoples (verses 24, 28, 31), not Israel only.
The verb (basar) is to bring news, usually good news, as in Isaiah 40:9 and 52:7.

decisions.choice: the lines of Psalm 96:1b and 96:2b joined
decisions.reason: Chronicles joins two half-lines of Psalm 96; the Swahili joins the Psalm's own half-lines.

decisions.choice: verses 23-33 keep the Korean wording of the published Psalm 96, line by line where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: This verse joins Psalm 96:1b and 96:2b; later verses join or reorder the psalm's lines as Chronicles does.
The verb is to announce good news (meaning m3). Hindi "सुसमाचार" is kept for the gospel of the New Testament, so the song says "शुभ समाचार".

decisions.choice: bassru "告げ知らせよ" (L), "良い知らせを告げよ" (B), "良い知らせを伝えよ" (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 7:9, besorah is 良い知らせ in the Old Testament, not the church word 福音.

source.text: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Recount among the nations his glory, among all the peoples his wonders.

en.L: Recount among the nations {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q among all the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders.
en.B: Tell the nations of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and all the peoples of the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.
en.R: Tell the other nations how great and glorious {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. \q Tell people everywhere about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

es.L: {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} entre las naciones {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q entre todos los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} maravillas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} a las naciones de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q y a todos los pueblos de las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuéntenles|Contadles}} a las otras naciones lo grande y glorioso que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es. \q {{plural_you:Cuéntenle|Contadle}} a la gente de todas partes las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

fr.L: Racontez parmi les nations {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q parmi tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles.
fr.B: Parlez aux nations de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et à tous les peuples des merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.
fr.R: Dites aux autres nations combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand et glorieux. \q Dites aux gens de partout les choses extraordinaires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.

sw.L: Simulieni kati ya mataifa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kati ya watu wote maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Yaelezeni mataifa habari za utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na watu wote habari za maajabu aliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Yaelezeni mataifa mengine jinsi alivyo mkuu na mtukufu. \q Waelezeni watu kila mahali mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.

vi.L: Hãy thuật lại giữa các dân tộc vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q giữa mọi dân những việc lạ lùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy kể cho các dân tộc về vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cho mọi dân về những việc diệu kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy nói cho các dân tộc khác biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại và vinh hiển biết bao. \q Hãy kể cho người ta khắp nơi về những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 민족들 가운데 그분의 영광을, \q 모든 백성들 가운데 그분의 기적들을 이야기하여라.
ko.B: 민족들에게 그분의 영광을 전하고, \q 모든 백성에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 알려라.
ko.R: 다른 민족들에게 그분이 얼마나 크고 영광스러우신지 말하여라. \q 모든 곳의 사람들에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 이야기하여라.

pt.L: Contem entre as nações a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q entre todos os povos as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: Falem às nações da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q e a todos os povos das maravilhas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: Contem às outras nações como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é grande e glorioso. \q Contem às pessoas de todo lugar as coisas incríveis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

am.L: ክብሩን በሕዝቦች መካከል ተናገሩ፤ \q ድንቅ ሥራዎቹንም በወገኖች ሁሉ መካከል።
am.B: ክብሩን ለሕዝቦች ንገሩ፤ \q ያደረጋቸውንም ድንቅ ነገሮች ለወገኖች ሁሉ።
am.R: እርሱ ምን ያህል ታላቅና ክቡር እንደ ሆነ ለሌሎች ሕዝቦች ንገሩ። \q ስላደረጋቸው አስደናቂ ነገሮች በየስፍራው ላሉ ሰዎች ንገሩ።

hi.L: जातियों में उनकी महिमा का, \q सब देशों के लोगों में उनके आश्चर्यकर्मों का वर्णन करो।
hi.B: देशों में उनकी महिमा का वर्णन करो, \q और सब लोगों में उनके किए हुए आश्चर्यकर्मों का।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों को बताओ कि वे कितने महान और महिमावान हैं। \q हर जगह के लोगों को उनके किए हुए अद्भुत कामों के बारे में बताओ।

ru.L: Возвещайте среди народов славу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \q среди всех народов — чудеса {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Расскажите народам о {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славе \q и всем народам — о чудесах, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил.
ru.R: Расскажите другим народам, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} велик и славен. \q Расскажите людям повсюду об удивительных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил.

ja.L: 諸国の民の中にその栄光を、 \q すべての民の中にその奇しいみわざを語り告げよ。
ja.B: その方の栄光を諸国の民に、 \q その方の行われた不思議なみわざをすべての民に語り告げよ。
ja.R: ほかの国々に、その方の偉大さと栄光を伝えよ。 \q その方のしてくださった驚くべきことを、世界中の人々に伝えよ。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:3, and its wording follows the psalm.
The word (kavod) is literally weight, and so the greatness and splendor of God that deserves honor.
The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, such as the rescue from Egypt (Exodus 3:20; Psalm 78:4).
Russian has no second common word for "peoples" that reads well in a hymn; "племена" would suggest tribes, so both lines say "народы".

source.text: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For great [is] Yahweh and to be praised exceedingly; and to be feared [is] he above all gods.

en.L: For great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and greatly to be praised; \q to be feared [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} above all gods.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and worthy of the highest praise; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} must be revered above every god.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} deserves all our praise. \q People should honor and fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} far more than any so-called god.

es.L: Porque grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y digno de suprema alabanza; \q temible [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sobre todos los dioses.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande y digno de la más alta alabanza; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} debe ser reverenciado sobre todo dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} merece toda nuestra alabanza. \q La gente debe honrarlo y temerlo mucho más que a cualquier supuesto dios.

fr.L: Car grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et très digne de louange ; \q et redoutable [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} par-dessus tous les dieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand et digne des plus hautes louanges ; \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut révérer, plus que tout dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mérite toutes nos louanges. \q Les gens devraient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindre bien plus que tous ces prétendus dieux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu na wa kusifiwa sana; \q wa kuogopwa [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kuliko miungu yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu na anastahili sifa kuu kuliko zote; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapaswa kuheshimiwa kwa hofu kuliko kila mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anastahili sifa zetu zote. \q Watu wanapaswa kumheshimu na kumcha kuliko kitu chochote kiitwacho mungu.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đáng kính sợ hơn mọi thần.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại và đáng được ca ngợi tột bậc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được tôn kính hơn mọi thần.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi. \q Người ta nên tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hơn mọi thứ người ta gọi là thần.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 크게 찬양받으실 분이시며, \q 모든 신들보다 경외받으실 분이시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시니 가장 높은 찬양을 받으셔야 마땅하고, \q 그 어떤 신보다 경외를 받으셔야 할 분이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 우리의 모든 찬양을 받으실 만하다. \q 사람들은 신이라 불리는 어떤 것보다 그분을 훨씬 더 두려워하며 높여야 한다.

pt.L: Porque grande [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e muito digno de louvor; \q e temível [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} acima de todos os deuses.
pt.B: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande e digno do mais alto louvor; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deve ser temido acima de todos os deuses.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} merece todo o nosso louvor. \q As pessoas devem honrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} e temê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} muito mais do que qualquer um desses chamados deuses.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነውና፤ እጅግም ሊመሰገን ይገባዋል፤ \q ከአማልክትም ሁሉ በላይ የሚፈራ እርሱ [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነውና፤ ከሁሉ የላቀ ምስጋናም ይገባዋል፤ \q ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ሊፈራ የሚገባው እርሱ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው፤ ምስጋናችንም ሁሉ ይገባዋል። \q ሰዎች አማልክት ከሚሏቸው ሁሉ ይልቅ እርሱን ሊያከብሩትና ሊፈሩት ይገባል።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान और अति स्तुति के योग्य [हैं]; \q वे सब देवताओं से अधिक भय के योग्य [हैं]।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं और सबसे बढ़कर स्तुति के योग्य हैं; \q हर देवता से बढ़कर उनका भय माना जाए।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं, और वे हमारी सारी स्तुति के योग्य हैं। \q लोग उन सब से कहीं बढ़कर, जिन्हें वे देवता कहते हैं, उनका आदर करें और उनका भय मानें।

ru.L: Потому что велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и весьма достоин хвалы, \q и страшен {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} превыше всех богов.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик и достоин высшей хвалы; \q перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} надо благоговеть больше, чем перед любым богом.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} достоин всей нашей хвалы. \q Люди должны чтить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и бояться {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} гораздо больше, чем любых так называемых богов.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる方、大いに賛美されるべき方。 \q その方はすべての神々にまさって恐れられるべき方。
ja.B: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大で、この上なく賛美されるべき方。 \q どの神々にもまさって、畏れ敬われるべき方。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方で、あらゆる賛美を受けるにふさわしい。 \q 神々と呼ばれるどんなものよりも、その方を敬い、恐れるべきだ。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:4, and its wording follows the psalm. Chronicles adds "and" before "to be feared", which changes nothing in the sense.

decisions.choice: to be feared: to be held in awe
decisions.reason: The form (nora') means one who is to be feared, that is, honored with awe and reverence (Psalm 47:3).
The other gods are not real rivals; the next verse says what they are.
Readable prepares for verse 26, which says these gods are nothing (m3), as at Psalm 96:4.
"Страшен" in its old sense, awe-inspiring (m2); the Balanced says "благоговеть", and the Readable both honour and fear.

source.text: כִּ֠י כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: For all [the] gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, but Yahweh made [the] heavens.

en.L: For all the gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the heavens.
en.B: For every god the peoples serve is a mere nothing, an idol, \q but it was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made the heavens.
en.R: The gods of the other nations are only idols. They are nothing! \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the sky above us.

es.L: Porque todos los dioses de los pueblos [son] ídolos sin valor, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo los cielos.
es.B: Porque todo dios al que sirven los pueblos es pura nada, un ídolo, \q pero fue {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien hizo los cielos.
es.R: Los dioses de las otras naciones son solo ídolos. ¡No son nada! \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo el cielo que está sobre nosotros.

fr.L: Car tous les dieux des peuples [sont] des idoles de néant, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait les cieux.
fr.B: Car tous les dieux que servent les peuples ne sont que du vide, des idoles, \q mais c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait les cieux.
fr.R: Les dieux des autres nations ne sont que des idoles. Ils ne sont rien ! \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait le ciel au-dessus de nous.

sw.L: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa [ni] sanamu zisizo na kitu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizifanya mbingu.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mungu wanayemtumikia watu ni bure, ni sanamu tu, \q lakini ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyezifanya mbingu.
sw.R: Miungu ya mataifa mengine ni sanamu tu. Si kitu! \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliumba anga lililo juu yetu.

vi.L: Vì mọi thần của các dân [là] những hình tượng hư không, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Vì mọi thần mà các dân thờ chỉ là hư không, là hình tượng, \q nhưng chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.R: Các thần của những dân khác chỉ là hình tượng. Chúng chẳng là gì cả! \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên bầu trời trên chúng ta.

ko.L: 참으로 백성들의 모든 신은 헛된 우상들이나, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘을 지으셨다.
ko.B: 백성들이 섬기는 신들은 모두 아무것도 아닌 우상일 뿐이지만, \q 하늘을 지으신 분은 바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 다른 민족들의 신들은 우상일 뿐이다. 그것들은 아무것도 아니다! \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 우리 위의 하늘을 만드셨다.

pt.L: Porque todos os deuses dos povos [são] ídolos sem valor, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez os céus.
pt.B: Porque todo deus que os povos servem é um nada, um ídolo, \q mas foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quem fez os céus.
pt.R: Os deuses das outras nações são só ídolos. Eles não são nada! \q Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez o céu que está acima de nós.

am.L: የሕዝቦች አማልክት ሁሉ ከንቱ ጣዖታት [ናቸውና]፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች የሚያመልኳቸው አማልክት ሁሉ ከንቱ ጣዖታት ናቸውና፤ \q ሰማይን የሠራ ግን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: የሌሎች ሕዝቦች አማልክት ጣዖታት ብቻ ናቸው፤ ምንም አይደሉም! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ከላይ ያለውን ሰማይ ሠራ።

hi.L: क्योंकि देश-देश के लोगों के सब देवता निकम्मी मूरतें [हैं], \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आकाश को बनाया।
hi.B: क्योंकि जिन देवताओं की लोग सेवा करते हैं, वे सब कुछ भी नहीं, बस मूरतें हैं, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही ने आकाश को बनाया।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों के देवता बस मूरतें हैं। वे कुछ भी नहीं! \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने हमारे ऊपर का आकाश बनाया।

ru.L: Потому что все боги народов — ничтожные идолы, \q а {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} создал небеса.
ru.B: Ведь все боги, которым служат народы, — пустое ничто, идолы, \q а небеса сотворил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Боги других народов — всего лишь идолы. Они ничто! \q А {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} создал небо над нами.

ja.L: まことに、もろもろの民の神々はみな、むなしい偶像である。 \q しかし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は天を造られた。
ja.B: 諸国の民が仕える神々はみな、むなしいもの、偶像にすぎない。 \q しかし、天を造られたのは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。
ja.R: ほかの国々の神々は、ただの偶像だ。何の力もない！ \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしたちの上に広がる天を造られた。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:5, and its wording follows the psalm.
The word ('elilim) means worthless things and is used for idols. It sounds like the word for gods ('elohim), a play on words: the gods of the peoples are no-gods (Isaiah 2:8; Leviticus 19:4).

decisions.choice: made the heavens: the Creator above the gods
decisions.reason: The nations' gods were made by people; the LORD made the sky, where the nations placed their gods. That is the proof of who is God (Psalm 115:3-4).

decisions.choice: 'elilim "むなしい偶像" (L), "むなしいもの、偶像" (B), "ただの偶像…何の力もない" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "nothings" and sounds like elohim; Japanese carries both the idol and its emptiness.

source.text: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Splendor and majesty [are] before him; strength and joy [are] in his place.

en.L: Splendor and majesty [are] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q strength and joy [are] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place.
en.B: Splendor and majesty stand in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q strength and joy fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dwells.
en.R: Glory and royal greatness surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Power and joy fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives.

es.L: Esplendor y majestad [hay] delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q poder y alegría [hay] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar.
es.B: El esplendor y la majestad están en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia; \q el poder y la alegría llenan el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habita.
es.R: La gloria y la grandeza real {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean. \q El poder y la alegría llenan el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive.

fr.L: La splendeur et la majesté [sont] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q la force et la joie [sont] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu.
fr.B: La splendeur et la majesté se tiennent en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q la force et la joie remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demeure.
fr.R: La gloire et la grandeur royale {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q La puissance et la joie remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite.

sw.L: Fahari na enzi [viko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na furaha [viko] mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}.
sw.B: Fahari na enzi vimesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na furaha vimejaa mahali anapokaa.
sw.R: Utukufu na ukuu wa kifalme vinamzunguka. \q Nguvu na furaha vimejaa mahali anapoishi.

vi.L: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi [ở] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và niềm vui [ở] trong nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.B: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và niềm vui tràn ngập nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.R: Vinh quang và sự cao cả của bậc đế vương bao quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Quyền năng và niềm vui tràn ngập nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở.

ko.L: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 [있고], \q 능력과 기쁨이 그분의 처소에 [있다].
ko.B: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 서 있고, \q 능력과 기쁨이 그분께서 계시는 곳에 가득하다.
ko.R: 영광과 왕다운 위엄이 그분을 둘러싸고 있다. \q 힘과 기쁨이 그분께서 계시는 곳에 가득하다.

pt.L: Esplendor e majestade [estão] diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}; \q força e alegria [estão] no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar.
pt.B: Esplendor e majestade estão na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença; \q força e alegria enchem o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} habita.
pt.R: Glória e grandeza de rei estão ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Poder e alegria enchem o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mora.

am.L: ግርማና ክብር በፊቱ [ናቸው]፤ \q ብርታትና ደስታ በስፍራው [ናቸው]።
am.B: ግርማና ክብር በፊቱ ይቆማሉ፤ \q ብርታትና ደስታ በሚኖርበት ስፍራ ሞልተዋል።
am.R: ክብርና የንጉሥ ታላቅነት ከበውታል። \q ኃይልና ደስታ በሚኖርበት ስፍራ ሞልተዋል።

hi.L: प्रताप और ऐश्वर्य उनके सामने [हैं]; \q सामर्थ्य और आनंद उनके स्थान में [हैं]।
hi.B: प्रताप और ऐश्वर्य उनकी उपस्थिति में रहते हैं; \q सामर्थ्य और आनंद उस स्थान को भर देते हैं जहाँ वे वास करते हैं।
hi.R: महिमा और राजसी वैभव उन्हें घेरे रहते हैं। \q जहाँ वे रहते हैं, वह जगह सामर्थ्य और आनंद से भरी है।

ru.L: Великолепие и величие перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; \q сила и радость в месте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Великолепие и величие стоят перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; \q сила и радость наполняют место, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} обитает.
ru.R: Слава и царское величие окружают {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \q Сила и радость наполняют место, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} живёт.

ja.L: 威光と威厳がその前にあり、 \q 力と喜びがその所にある。
ja.B: 輝きと威厳がその御前にあり、 \q 力と喜びが、その方の住まわれる所に満ちている。
ja.R: 栄光と王の偉大さが、その方を取り囲んでいる。 \q その方の住まわれる所には、力と喜びが満ちている。

decisions.reason: Psalm 96:6 reads "strength and beauty are in his sanctuary". Here the line reads "strength and joy are in his place". The ark had no temple yet, only the tent David pitched (verse 1), and the joy of the day is part of what surrounds God. The first half of the line is the same as the psalm, and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: splendor and majesty: the glory of a king
decisions.reason: The pair (hod, hadar) is used of a king's splendor (Psalms 21:6; 45:4). Here they stand before the LORD like attendants at his throne.

decisions.choice: his place: where God dwells among his people
decisions.reason: The word (maqom) is the ordinary word for a place, and is used of the place God chooses for his name (Deuteronomy 12:5) and of the place prepared for the ark (15:1, 3).

decisions.choice: the place where he dwells (B); the place where he lives (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "his place" is: God's dwelling. Readable keeps the words of Psalm 96:6.

decisions.choice: alegría; su lugar (for the psalm's "beauty" and "sanctuary")
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "joy" and "his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "beauty" and "his sanctuary"; the Spanish changes those two words and keeps the rest of the psalm's wording.
Chronicles has "strength and joy in his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "strength and beauty in his sanctuary"; the Swahili follows Chronicles.
Chronicles has "joy" and "his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "beauty" and "his sanctuary"; the Korean changes those words only.

source.text: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to Yahweh, clans of [the] peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, families of the peoples, \q ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and strength.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what is due, you families of the nations; \q give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and might.
en.R: Give honor to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you families and nations! \q Say that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is glorious and strong.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, familias de los pueblos, \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y poder.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lo que le corresponde, familias de las naciones; \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y fuerza.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todas las familias y naciones! \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es glorioso y fuerte.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, familles des peuples, \q rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et force.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est dû, familles des nations ; \q donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et puissance.
fr.R: Rendez honneur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous toutes, familles et nations ! \q Dites que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est glorieux et fort.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi jamaa za mataifa, \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na nguvu.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachostahili, enyi jamaa za mataifa; \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na uweza.
sw.R: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} heshima, enyi jamaa zote na mataifa! \q Semeni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mtukufu na mwenye nguvu.

vi.L: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các dòng họ của các dân, \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và sức mạnh.
vi.B: Hỡi các dòng họ của các dân tộc, hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng nhận; \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và quyền năng.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi gia tộc và mọi dân tộc, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy nói rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh hiển và mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라, 백성들의 족속들아, \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라.
ko.B: 민족들의 모든 가문들아, 마땅한 것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라. \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라.
ko.R: 모든 가문과 민족들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 영광스럽고 강하시다고 말하여라.

pt.L: Atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, famílias dos povos, \q atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e força.
pt.B: Deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} é devido, famílias das nações; \q deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e poder.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as famílias e nações! \q Digam que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é glorioso e forte.

am.L: የሕዝቦች ጎሳዎች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ፤ \q ክብርንና ብርታትን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ።
am.B: የሕዝቦች ጎሳዎች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚገባውን ስጡ፤ \q ክብርንና ኃይልን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ።
am.R: ጎሳዎችና ሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አክብሩ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክቡርና ብርቱ እንደ ሆነ ተናገሩ።

hi.L: हे देश-देश के कुलो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को दो, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को महिमा और सामर्थ्य दो।
hi.B: हे देशों के कुलो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को वह दो जो उनका हक़ है; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को महिमा और सामर्थ्य दो।
hi.R: हे सब कुलो और देशो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर करो! \q मान लो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महिमावान और सामर्थी हैं।

ru.L: Воздайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, роды народов, \q воздайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу и силу.
ru.B: Отдайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} должное, роды народов; \q отдайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу и могущество.
ru.R: Воздайте честь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, все роды и народы! \q Говорите, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} славен и силён.

ja.L: もろもろの民の諸氏族よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。 \q 栄光と力を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。
ja.B: 諸国の民の家族たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にふさわしいものを帰せよ。 \q 栄光と力を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。
ja.R: すべての家族、すべての国々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をたたえよ！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は栄光に満ち、力ある方だと言い表せ。

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:7, and its wording follows the psalm.
The verb (yahav) is simply "give"; giving glory and strength to God is acknowledging that they are his.
Verses 28-29 echo Psalm 29:1-2, where the same call is made to the heavenly beings; here it goes out to the families of all the peoples (Genesis 12:3).
Literal says "atribuam", acknowledging that glory and strength are the LORD's (m2), as the English "ascribe"; Balanced uses the plain verb "dar", as the English "give".

The Hebrew verb is "give" (meaning m2); Hindi "महिमा देना" is the ordinary way to say giving glory to God, so Literal and Balanced keep "दो" here and in verse 29. Readable says what the giving is: honour God and acknowledge his glory and strength.
"Род" is this translation's word for a clan (the Pentateuch note); the Readable lists families and nations side by side, as the English does.

decisions.choice: havu "帰せよ" (L, B), "たたえよ" / "言い表せ" (R)
decisions.reason: To acknowledge and give God what is his due; Readable says it plainly as the English does.

source.text: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to Yahweh [the] glory of his name; lift up an offering and come before him; bow down to Yahweh in [the] adornment of holiness.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q lift up an offering and come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in [the] splendor of holiness.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves; \q bring a gift and come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q bow low before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves. \q Bring a gift and come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Bow down and worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is holy and glorious.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} una ofrenda y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en [el] esplendor de la santidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria que merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} un presente y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia; \q {{plural_you:inclínense|inclinaos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en santo esplendor.
es.R: {{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q {{plural_you:Tráiganle|Traedle}} un regalo y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q {{plural_you:Inclínense|Inclinaos}} y {{plural_you:adoren|adorad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que es santo y glorioso.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez une offrande et venez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans [la] splendeur de la sainteté.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire que mérite {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez un don et venez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q inclinez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom le mérite. \q Apportez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un don et venez vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Inclinez-vous et adorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est saint et glorieux.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni sadaka mkaje mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q msujudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika uzuri wa utakatifu.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu unaostahili jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni zawadi mkaje mbele {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q inameni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika fahari takatifu.
